implementation.preserved_filter: C101..C116100nF from INi to GND; all DI reverse diodes and TVS retained
implementation.firmware_requirement: MCP GPPUA/GPPUB=0: initialization, readback and reset recovery updated; 22/22 host driver tests and ESP-IDF6.1 build passed. See TLP2363-firmware-validation.json. Physical board validation pending.
implementation.engineering_input_envelope_scope: 12V +/-10% is an explicit design assumption; minimum IF must be verified with the chosen PSU, wiring, contact resistance and temperature.
implementation.VF2p0V_scope: Engineering allowance; the Toshiba1.65V VFmaximum is only specified at2.6mA25C and is not treated as a guaranteed all-temperature value.
implementation.lower3v3_envelope_scope: 3.3V +/-5% is an engineering review envelope, not a guaranteed all-temperature TLV1117LV accuracy claim. Full assembled-rail transient/temperature validation remains necessary.
implementation.common_ground_scope: DI LED/cable return and detector logic both use GND. Optical transfer does not establish galvanic isolation of the complete external dry-contact domain; no port-to-port isolation or assembly voltage-withstand rating is claimed.
prototype_checks: Measure lowest3V3, LOW/HIGH margins, relay-switch transients and brownout/reset behavior with all16 inputs closed and all16 relay coils energized.
Verify IF>=5mA at minimum external supply, cold, maximum intended cable/contact resistance; verify input resistor temperature at maximum supply.
Verify total common5V load, lower LDO temperature and R12 temperature in the intended enclosure; regulator efficiency and component temperature are not inferred from package ratings.
Verify all16 input transitions and readback/recovery with MCP GPPU disabled; check intended debounce and cable pickup after routing.

lower_LDO.accuracy_scope: TI electrical table defaults to25C unless specified; do not treat its +/-1.5% output accuracy as an all-temperature/transient guarantee.

current_12v.audit: Power-budget.json input_12v.calculation and TLP2363-power-budget.json are current; Lower F1-current-audit.json is the historical pre-U12-R78 fuse selection and geometry record

calculation.scope: Simultaneous design allocations including0.3mA FRAM and16x4mA TLP2363 detector supply. DI LED drop1.2V is retained as an engineering current-budget assumption, not an all-temperature Toshiba VF minimum; the separate IFminimum design uses2.0V. protected_12v_RC.topology: Lower D3 cathode -> +12V_LOGIC_RAW -> R12 -> +12V_LOGIC; C8/C2/C13 and all regulator inputs remain after R12
protected_12v_RC.manufacturer_full_power_condition: 300 mm2 total solder pad and trace area at 70 C; 2 W is not a demonstrated PCB assembly thermal rating
protected_12v_RC.upstream_voltage_scope: Engineering 12 V source minus assumed D1/D3 drops, not a guaranteed minimum for every PSU/diode/temperature
protected_12v_RC.formula: I*(11.2-I*R)=P; choose the low-current stable operating root
protected_12v_RC.temperature_scope: Above corner is resistor initial tolerance at the assumed input/load. TCR, diode drop, supply tolerance and converter efficiency vary with temperature; actual enclosure validation required.
protected_12v_RC.filter_scope: First-order unloaded RC estimate only; actual ESR, wiring inductance, converter input impedance and local decoupling change the response. RC does not clamp sustained overvoltage or guarantee EMC/reset immunity.

startup_pulse.capacitance_scope: Engineering ceiling including tolerances and module input capacitance; listed external nominal capacitors sum262.2uF. Unknown module internal capacitance and actual PSU startup must be verified.
startup_pulse.manufacturer_curve_category: Nominal resistance >=1 ohm; CRM datasheet page3
startup_pulse.comparison: The first1ms instantaneous bound176W is below the approximate220W rectangular-pulse graph. This is an engineering comparison, not repetitive/hot-start/surge qualification.
startup_pulse.tail_scope: The pure-RC tail excludes running converter load. Actual startup and repeated restart waveform/temperature remain prototype checks; do not infer full-circuit tail power from the unloaded RC formula.

calculation_method.numerical_scope: Calculations retain existing nominal diode-drop/rail/efficiency assumptions. Budgets are not measurements, guaranteed maxima over all ambient/input/load corners, inrush ratings or completed EMC qualification.

historical_report_scope: Preceding source hashes and results remain historical. They are not rewritten to claim certification of changed TLP2363 topology or routing.
